critical_help_or_return_note: If extraction omits necessary action controls or qualifiers, the main content tells the voter to return to the full official page or use the named official help route.
delivery_role_note: Bounded reader/simplified-view review surface for an official voter-information route that may be consumed through browser Reader View, simplified print preview, or other extracted-main-content presentation.
main_content_authority_note: If the route is read in a simplified extracted view, the controlling answer, office identity, timing cue, and next-step/help path remain inside the extractable main content or the page explicitly says full view is required.
reader_mode_surface_label: Example reader-mode and simplified-view posture for an official voter-information route
reader_view_action_boundary_note: Simplified reading views are classified as reader-safe, summary-only, or full-view-required so readability is not mistaken for action completeness.
